# Lucas Arana

> Official personal website of Lucas Arana, Software engineer & COO at Nexton, based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. His work connects Latin American engineers with US companies.

Lucas joined Nexton in 2019 and leads operations, talent strategy and revenue operations. He writes about technical hiring, distributed engineering teams and AI in business operations. This site has an interactive 3D portfolio and a separate text-based writing and profile page.

## Profile and writing

- [Lucas Arana — profile](https://lucasarana.com/index.md): biography, role, work, contact and explanation of the interactive world.
- [Writing index](https://lucasarana.com/writing/index.md): selected post titles and links to Lucas's original LinkedIn writing.
- [Full text overview](https://lucasarana.com/llms-full.txt): profile and writing index combined.

## Official links

- [Lucas Arana on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/lucasarana/): primary way to connect with Lucas.
- [Email Lucas](mailto:lucas.arana@nexton.dev): professional email.
- [Nexton](https://nexton.dev): company website.
